description:
Compare 2 to 4 areas in India side by side: price today, price outlook, building growth, how built-up, govt. rates.

Use for "Whitefield vs Gachibowli", "compare these three villages".
Returns a table with one column per area and a link to each area's page.
Prices are labelled by kind; a city-wide average is marked and is not
comparable with a govt. rate. Names take the best search match: for
villages with common names, find coordinates with footprint_search_places
first and pass 'lat,lon'.

places.description: 2 to 4 places. Each is a name ('Whitefield Bengaluru') or coordinates as 'lat,lon' ('12.9698,77.7499').
